description:
Latest bank rates

Each bank's latest buying and selling rate per currency, in TRY, with the spread. Rates are read from the banks' public pages every 5 minutes on weekdays (hourly otherwise); `observedAt` is the last read and `changedAt` when the rate last moved. Filter by `bank` and `currencies`. Use when the user asks what Turkish banks charge or pay for USD, EUR, GBP or another currency, or for one bank's rates. `buying` is what the bank pays you for one unit (you sell); `selling` is what you pay the bank (you buy). For the official TCMB rate use the currency (FX) tools instead.

GET /v1/bank-fx/rates on Bank exchange rates (SBX-BANKFX). Costs 1 credit per call.
